annotations.title: Can AI agents use this site?

description: What the scan found about AI agents on a public site: its agent-readiness level (L0 unreachable to L4 agent-native) with what holds it there, each AI crawler or assistant robots.txt lets in or not and what our request in its name got, whether llms.txt exists, and report_url — the full view on convertlyft.com/agent-readiness. Reads the same crawl as cvl_public_seo_scan, never a second one: pass the scan_id you already have, or a url (which starts or reuses that scan). Waits up to about 45 seconds. No account needed. Without one, the limits per address are 20 calls a minute and 200 a day, and 10,000 calls a day across everyone without an account (past one, HTTP 429 naming it, with Retry-After); and 5 new scans a day per address, or per workspace when signed in (a reused scan does not count). Past the scan limit the answer is an error naming it, with retry_after_seconds.
